description: PBY-5A Catalina, ex US Navy BuNo 48397, c/n 1759, owned by Thomas W. Kendall of La Verne, California, on a round-the-world family flight; ran onto the beach reef at Ras Al-Sheikh Hamid on 23 Mar 1960 after being shot up by local tribesmen and was abandoned (aerialvisuals dossier; Aviation Safety Network). The hulk has remained on the beach ever since and is a well-known landmark (OSM names the access track Plane Wreck Trail). This is an unrestored wreck, not a curated display; included because it is a publicly visited historic airframe. Position from aerialvisuals 28.09091 34.60859.
